rationale: This is a self-contained competitive programming problem solvable in a single file under 200 LOC. All logic (input parsing, DP recurrence, pattern matching) shares the same data flow and there are no independent subsystems.
We need to count overlapping occurrences efficiently. KMP gives O(n+m) matching and handles overlaps naturally by not resetting the automaton state.

decision: Store prefix/suffix of length len(p)-1 at each DP step
rationale: Cross-boundary matches can only start within the last len(p)-1 characters of F(k-1) and end within the first len(p)-1 characters of F(k-2). This keeps boundary strings bounded regardless of the exponential growth of F(n).
